rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_allow_scope.go: resolves the current guard-launch session identifier for overlay and session-scope selection, preferring the programmatic guardAllowSessionScopeID override, then the trimmed FAK_GUARD_SESSION_ID value, and otherwise returning empty; remote-maintenance administration also treats a non-empty result as a supplemental reason to refuse that CLI invocation.
rows.distinction: A caller-removable session marker, not proof of operator identity or maintenance authority - NOT the reviewed remote-maintenance grant, lease, or policy authorization; NOT FAK_GUARD_SESSION_ID (the transported environment value) and NOT guardAllowLayersWithSessionScope (the session policy-layer appender).
